newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quoted higher amid firm swaps.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quoted higher amid firm swaps.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers raised their offers on Tuesday amid firm fuel oil swaps and sentiment was helped after Japanese traders returned to their desks from a long weekend holiday, traders said.
"Enquiries are slightly better today. I am raising the quotes," said one trader, noting May fuel oil swaps which rose to $99.75/$101.00 from Monday's $99.00/$99.50.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted by majors at $106/$107 per tonne and the 380-cst was at about $100/$101.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $193/$195 and $203/$205 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
